answer: Each identity enrolls a handwritten signature on a marble tablet, a trellis of 40 stroke waypoints, with a 20 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch the holder signs a random 6-word phrase in 90 seconds; the pressure signal must match within 5%, and two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts. Forging 100 profiles needs 100 hands, so 100 fakes cost 2,000 POA plus 150 minutes of signing per epoch, each extra fake costlier, dodging all enrolled profiles. Hashes sit on-chain for any verifier to replay. A household sharing one tablet is the failure case: members pass a video check.
